definitions.gloss: gift; present (formal); offering to a superior
definitions.explanation: A formal gift presented to someone, especially to a superior, business associate, or on ceremonial occasions. More formal than プレゼント or 贈り物.

examples.japanese: {進物|しんもつ}⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{包装|ほうそう}→包装：11932_housou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お{願|ねが}いします。
⟦お{中元|ちゅうげん}→お中元：06125_ochuugen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{進物|しんもつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んでいる→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{和菓子|わがし}→和菓子：04962_wagashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{進物|しんもつ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧、⟦お{歳暮|せいぼ}→お歳暮：06126_oseibo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{売|う}れる→売れる：02012_ureru⟧。
examples.english: These Japanese sweets are popular as formal gifts and sell well during the year-end gift season.

notes:
A formal term for gifts, especially in the context of Japan's gift-giving culture. Used heavily in department stores and specialty shops during ⟦お{中元|ちゅうげん}→お中元：06125_ochuugen⟧ and ⟦お{歳暮|せいぼ}→お歳暮：06126_oseibo⟧ seasons.

FORMS:
{進|しん} (to advance, to present) + {物|もつ} (thing). The idea is something "presented forward" to someone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {進物|しんもつ}⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧: for gift-giving purposes
- {進物|しんもつ}⟦コーナー→コーナー：10865_koonaa⟧: gift section (in a department store)
- {進物|しんもつ}⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧: gift items
- {進物|しんもつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{最適|さいてき}→最適：13010_saiteki⟧: ideal as a gift

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{贈|おく}り{物|もの}→贈り物：01343_okurimono⟧: gift, present — the most common general word
- ⟦プレゼント→プレゼント：01791_purezento⟧: present — casual, often for personal occasions like birthdays
- ⟦{手土産|てみやげ}→手土産：08353_temiyage⟧: gift brought when visiting someone
- {献上品|けんじょうひん}: tribute, offering to a high-ranking person — even more formal

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan has a strong tradition of formal gift-giving, particularly during the ⟦お{中元|ちゅうげん}→お中元：06125_ochuugen⟧ (mid-year) and ⟦お{歳暮|せいぼ}→お歳暮：06126_oseibo⟧ (year-end) seasons. {進物|しんもつ} is the standard term used in these contexts.
